title: Constant Acceleration Flow
tldr_zh: 常加速度二次轨迹 + 初速度条件化消除路径交叉歧义；CIFAR-10 一步 FID 4.81（+GAN 1.39），耦合保持 PSNR 46.68 vs RF 33.34
tldr_en: Constant-acceleration ODE with initial-velocity conditioning resolves flow crossing; one-step CIFAR-10 FID 4.81 (1.39 with GAN), ImageNet-64 1.69 with GAN, far better coupling preservation than rectified flow.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 one-step FID: CAF 4.81 uncond / 2.68 cond; CAF+GAN 1.48 / 1.39 (Table 1)
ImageNet-64 one-step FID: CAF 6.52 (Rec 0.62); CAF+GAN 1.69 (IS 62.03, Rec 0.64) vs CTM 1.92, DMD 2.62 (Table 2)
Coupling preservation on CIFAR-10 1K pairs: LPIPS 0.041 vs 2-RF 0.092; PSNR 33.16 vs 29.79 (Table 3)
Reconstruction one-step PSNR 46.68 / LPIPS 0.007 vs 2-RF two-step 33.34 / 0.094 (Table 6)
Ablation cond CIFAR-10 N=1: 2-RF 6.88 -> constant accel 3.82 -> +IVC (h=1.5) 2.68 (Table 5)
N-step CAF needs N+1 NFE (Appendix D.1); adversarial stage 21 days x 8 A100 on ImageNet (Appendix A)
